The Riddle:

"Today I have 3 apples. Yesterday I ate 1 apple. How many do I have today?"

The Answer

3

You have exactly three apples.

psychology

Why isn't it 2?

This is a linguistic trick! The phrase "Today I have 3" is a statement of current fact (a "State Declaration").

What happened yesterday (eating an apple) is irrelevant history because the first sentence explicitly tells us the count right now.
